note: The journalist's desk: the cycle every evidence export goes through, the full pass and where it stands, and the pass ledger, one row per hand-kept data file with the evidence vault head it was last checked against. Kept by correspondent@php.newsroom (until 24 October, claude-journalist). The staleness report on /views/desk/ is computed from this file, the built pages and the vault's claims at every build.
author: claude-journalist

decided.says: the journalist does the full pass and maintains the site after each export as part of its workflow, released in turn rather than in one large push; and, the same day, the pipeline: researcher, curator, journalist (Sonnet, publishes), correspondent (Opus, reviews and writes the analysis), then the ontologist, the librarian and the desk

cycle.label: Research
cycle.what: Makes the network requests to the live websites and keeps everything it reads in the source-watch vault, the largest vault.

cycle.label: Curate
cycle.what: Reads only the researcher's vault, reads each capture, and writes promotions, claims and timeline rows into the evidence vault.

cycle.label: Publish
cycle.what: Reads only the evidence vault: exports it, gives every new claim a verdict, refreshes the data the pages draw from, and releases to the live site.

cycle.label: Review
cycle.what: Reads what went live, fixes and tweaks it in the open, writes the state of affairs and the analysis, and tightens the journalist's rules.

cycle.who: the ontologist, the librarian and the desk
cycle.label: Graphs
cycle.what: Only after the correspondent: the semantic graphs, the parties and the attribution are brought up to the reviewed data.

cycle.label: Settled
cycle.what: The report at the foot of this page is empty: no 'as of' older than the latest capture, every file checked against the current head, every vault claim reviewed.

pass.title: The desk, the plan and the staleness report
pass.what: This page: the cycle, the pass, the pass ledger and the report that says what is still stale.

pass.title: Refresh the hand-kept data from the new evidence
pass.what: Story, the compromise line, the offline ledger, agencies, numbers, the timeline, the KEV snapshot and the software inventory, each checked against the current head. Done so far: the compromise evidence and claim, the offline list, the story summary, the front page's dated lines, the 'been hacked' answer, the context row and the 22.6 million figure, at 1f38e70921b2; to do: agencies, numbers in full, the timeline, the software inventory, defence and affected systems.

pass.title: Move the facts typed into the build into data
pass.what: Front-page tiles, KEV, playbook, the Explained page, chart windows and counts read from data, so the next export changes them without code.

pass.title: The persona pass
pass.what: The sixteen readers' answers, introductions and asks move into personas.json, with their 'as of' generated, and are re-read against the state of affairs.

pass.title: Review the rest of the curator's claims
pass.what: Every claim on /claims/review/ gets a verdict; the used ones go into the site's claim table with their sources.

kept_as_written_why: Stories, updates, versions of the state of affairs, release notes, briefs, outside readings and source pages are dated and kept as written by design; a dated phrase in them is history, not staleness. Facts pages carry every version of a fact. The state of affairs gives each measure its own as-of time on purpose.
